name: Antipodal, Acycloid, and Respectful-Expansion Equivalence
statement: Unique graph antipodes in a partial cube, a simple acycloid tope representation, and construction from $K_1$ by antipodality-respectful expansions define the same class.
proof: The intrinsic hypercube coordinates of an antipodal partial cube are closed under simultaneous sign reversal, giving a simple acycloid; its symmetric isometric sign graph has unique absolute antipodes. Contracting a $\Theta$-class preserves the antipodal involution, and reversing these contractions gives expansion covers exchanged by that involution. Conversely, each respectful expansion extends the involution and preserves unique antipodes.
